baseline_plan.starting_revision: Pin the baseline after Lefthook ships, so completed S1/S2 and artifact fixes are not misattributed to this redesign. Record repository SHA, wheel SHA, host binary/version, actual model/effort, selected skills, prompt/context size and machine conditions.
baseline_plan.comparison: Within each family, interleave baseline/candidate runs using the same model, effort, permissions and initial fixture. Compare Claude and Codex separately; do not attribute differences between models to harness architecture. Separate interactive guidance trials from headless-loop trials.
baseline_plan.sampling: Start with three independent repetitions per case/arm/family, expand to five and beyond when a regression or uncertainty changes the decision. Retain every attempt, failure, timeout and intervention. A few trials support directional findings, not a reliable p95 estimate.

baseline_plan.held_out: Separate unpublished fixture variants and seeded reviewer defects from cases used to tune prompts. Include correct clean changes to measure false findings. Freeze oracles before candidate output; do not choose best configuration using the final holdout.

measurements.quality: Per-case acceptance verdict and required-fact retention; permission violation or history loss is a release blocker regardless of speed.
measurements.time: Elapsed accepted outcome including retries, reviews and verification; instrument startup, model wait, tools, queue, review and repair only where identifiable. Overlapping spans are not summed as wall time.
measurements.cost: Reuse RunRecord input/output/cache/reasoning token fields and provider-reported cost. Unknown remains null with provenance. Cost per success includes failed attempts; zero-success cohorts are undefined, not zero.
measurements.latency_report: Show raw samples, median and observed maximum initially. Publish tail percentiles only with sample count and uncertainty; do not label small-sample maximum a reliable p95.
measurements.usability: Track interventions, duplicate reads, unnecessary handoffs and CLI commands required to find active work; measure live board navigation separately from HTTP endpoint latency.

baseline_plan.tracker_board: Use disposable snapshots of representative small/current/expanded ledgers. Exercise planned, ongoing, blocked, reviewing, finished, cancelled and disconnected states; include closed-item search, live updates and reconnect. Measure cold load and warm card-open/list/search, update-to-visible delay, transferred bytes and correctness against canonical ledger. Set budgets from measured baseline and user needs before UI implementation; do not invent achieved thresholds.
baseline_plan.exclusions: Do not use unchanged skill-creator run_eval or aggregate_benchmark as baseline authority: controls already confirmed failure-as-success, wrong run counts and token units. Lexical retention is a supplementary probe, not task quality.
baseline_plan.execution_boundary: Use isolated temporary consumer ledgers and worktrees; never run task trials against the shared production tracker or modify concurrent-session branches. Respect host credentials and permissions without dumping configuration secrets.

current_official_loading_facts.finding: Progressive disclosure begins with name, description and path; selected skills load their full instructions. Initial listing budget is distinct from body cost. Scripts and references are optional; use clear scope boundaries.

Global override precedes global AGENTS; project discovery walks root to cwd, one file per directory with override preference. Combined default cap is 32 KiB. Do not treat all nested repository AGENTS files as startup context.

Official evaluation guidance separates invocation quality from output quality and recommends fresh-session baseline comparisons. Skill listing has ongoing context cost; telemetry should inform investigation, not prove non-use outside its observation window.
